title: 危害与风险评估
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/37_BIORISK ASSESSMENT HAZARDS AND RISKS.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/37_BIORISK ASSESSMENT HAZARDS AND RISKS/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在天平图标前，一端危害一端风险
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a balance scale icon.
shots.narration: 这一课，学会辨危害、评风险。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现放大镜和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside a magnifying glass and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先看清，再防住。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿到一盒样本就想马上开做
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a sample box and reaches to open it eagerly.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到样本，想立刻开工。

shots.scene: 小研摆手拦住，拿出空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves to stop him and holds a blank form.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：先评估再动手。

shots.scene: 王老师点头，身后一面空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator nods beside a blank flow chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 王老师说：风险，是能理清的。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向实验室里多种危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at several hazard icons in a lab.
shots.narration: 实验室里，危害不止一种。

shots.scene: 生物、化学、电、火、辐射图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: biohazard, chemical, electricity, fire, radiation. No people.
shots.narration: 生物、化学、电、火、辐射都算。

shots.scene: 四个目标图标竖排点亮
shots.prompt_en: Four objective icons light up in a column. No people.
shots.narration: 本讲有四个目标。

shots.scene: 三个对勾方框依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three check boxes get ticked one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 学完要能定义、识别、会评估。

shots.scene: 一只手打翻杯子又及时扶住，地上没洒
shots.prompt_en: A hand knocks a blank cup but catches it in time; nothing spills. No people.
shots.narration: 险情：差点出事，还没伤人。

shots.scene: 出现一个问号和一个安全对勾
shots.prompt_en: A question mark next to a safety tick. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫险兆，是个警告。

shots.scene: 杯子真打翻，地上出现警示标
shots.prompt_en: A blank cup tips over; a warning mark appears on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 事故：非预期，已经造成伤害。

shots.scene: 一辆车停在车库，旁边放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A parked car in a garage, with a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：有伤人潜能的东西。

shots.scene: 同一辆车开上马路，危险显现
shots.prompt_en: The same car now drives onto a busy road. No people.
shots.narration: 车本身不危险，一上路就有风险。

shots.scene: 六个危害图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Six hazard icons arranged in a ring. No people.
shots.narration: 常见危害：盗窃、火、辐射、

shots.scene: 滑倒、生物、电气三个图标点亮
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up: a slip sign, a biohazard, a power plug. No people.
shots.narration: 滑倒、生物、电气也在其中。

shots.scene: 一个天平：左盘可能性，右盘严重性
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: likelihood on the left, severity on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 风险：可能性和严重性的组合。

shots.scene: 骰子代表可能性，警示牌代表后果
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon for likelihood, a warning sign for consequence. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性是几率，后果是大小。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志旁出现天平
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard symbol beside a balance scale. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害源是生物因子，就叫生物风险。

shots.scene: 一个危害图标顺箭头变成风险图标
shots.prompt_en: A hazard icon turns into a risk icon along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 一动起来，危害就变成风险。

shots.scene: 操作、运输、盗窃、封闭破损四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a procedure, a transport truck, a theft hand, a broken barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 操作、运输、盗窃、封闭破损都是。

shots.scene: 一条上升的阶梯，每级配一个流程图标
shots.prompt_en: A rising staircase, each step marked with a process icon. No people.
shots.narration: 流程一步步走，风险一级级升。

shots.scene: 阶梯顶端出现放大的风险箭头
shots.prompt_en: An enlarged red risk arrow at the top of the staircase. No people.
shots.narration: 越往后，释放的后果越大。

shots.scene: 五个方块连成一条链
shots.prompt_en: Five blocks joined into a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 管理分五步：识别、评估、

shots.scene: 链条后两块：残余风险、决策
shots.prompt_en: The last two blocks of the chain: residual risk and decision. No people.
shots.narration: 控制、残余风险、再决策。

shots.scene: 一个危害被放进对应的分组格子
shots.prompt_en: A hazard token is placed into a matching group slot. No people.
shots.narration: 识别：认出危害，归入它的组。

shots.scene: 一台平板显示空白资料页
shots.prompt_en: A tablet showing a blank data sheet page. No people.
shots.narration: 查病原资料，拿到先验依据。

shots.scene: 一把尺子量现有控制够不够
shots.prompt_en: A ruler measuring whether existing controls are enough. No people.
shots.narration: 评估：看现有控制够不够。

shots.scene: 一个对勾和一个问号在天平两端
shots.prompt_en: A tick and a question mark on a balance. No people.
shots.narration: 够，就可接受；不够，再加。

shots.scene: 一座五层金字塔
shots.prompt_en: A five-layer pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 控制分五类，从上到下：

shots.scene: 金字塔下两层点亮
shots.prompt_en: The bottom two layers of the pyramid light up. No people.
shots.narration: 管理控制，最后才是个人防护。

shots.scene: 一个风险球缩小但没消失
shots.prompt_en: A risk ball shrinks but does not disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 残余风险：降得下，清不了零。

shots.scene: 小研、阿杰、王老师围着一份样本图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator around a sample icon.
shots.narration: 案例：团队一起管一份样本。

shots.scene: 样本卡上只有空白图标和一个编号位
shots.prompt_en: A sample card with blank icons and a number slot. No people.
shots.narration: 样本已知感染性，属危害组四。

shots.scene: 一条流程线分成六段
shots.prompt_en: A process line split into six segments. No people.
shots.narration: 把流程拆开：运输、接收、储存、

shots.scene: 后三段点亮：处理、处置、数据
shots.prompt_en: The last three segments light up: processing, disposal, data. No people.
shots.narration: 处理、处置、数据传输。

shots.scene: 一张清单，六个检查项
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with six inspection items. No people.
shots.narration: 先查控制够不够：设施、仪器、

shots.scene: 清单后三项打勾：培训、处置、应急
shots.prompt_en: The last three items ticked: training, disposal, emergency plan. No people.
shots.narration: 人员、培训、处置、应急预案。

shots.scene: 两个方向的箭头：对内对外
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows, one pointing inward and one outward. No people.
shots.narration: 要评两类：生物安全和安保。

shots.scene: 一是人员暴露，二是蓄意盗取
shots.prompt_en: One icon of worker exposure, one of a theft hand. No people.
shots.narration: 人员社区会暴露，样本会被盗。

shots.scene: 一个柜子图标外再套一圈围墙
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet icon with a wall ring around it. No people.
shots.narration: 两道屏障：柜护人，房护环境。

shots.scene: 流程线每一段都插上一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: Each segment of the process line gets a small flag. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步，都插旗评一次。

shots.scene: 一张四乘四的彩色矩阵
shots.prompt_en: A four-by-four coloured matrix grid. No people.
shots.narration: 矩阵打分：后果配可能性。

shots.scene: 矩阵四档从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: The matrix cells shade from green to red across four levels. No people.
shots.narration: 低、中、高、很高，颜色一看就懂。

shots.scene: 一张按流程排列的总体风险表
shots.prompt_en: An overall risk table arranged by process step. No people.
shots.narration: 总体表：全程风险一行看清。

shots.scene: 前段标红、后段转绿
shots.prompt_en: Early rows turn red, later rows turn green. No people.
shots.narration: 样本灭活后，盗取风险就降了。

shots.scene: 一个岔路口，牌子写着决策
shots.prompt_en: A fork in the road with a decision signpost. No people.
shots.narration: 决策点：残余风险，够不够？

shots.scene: 一条路通向减缓措施图标
shots.prompt_en: One path leads to a mitigation icon. No people.
shots.narration: 评完，再进下一步减缓。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁：天平、放大镜、五步链
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside a balance, a magnifying glass and a five-step chain.
shots.narration: 危害变风险，五步能管住。

shots.scene: 矩阵、两道屏障、决策岔路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a matrix, two barriers, a decision fork. No people.
shots.narration: 矩阵打分、两道屏障、看残余。

shots.scene: 欣欣把本课要点拼成一块盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot assembles the key points into a shield.
shots.narration: 评清楚、控到位，再做决定。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手，身后盾牌发亮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with a glowing shield behind.
shots.narration: 做好评估，我们下次见！
